target_policy: Only final target-reviewed entries; unavailable/withheld/unchanged faces stay excluded. Target drafts do not grant matching eligibility.

matching.scope: Exact complete message or strong punctuation-delimited sentence unit,1–5words; never arbitrary prefix or substring.
matching.normalization: NFKC/casefold, curly apostrophe to straight and whitespace collapse; retain original UTF16 offsets. Punctuation is not discarded before speech-act checks.
matching.boundaries: Whole message, or . ! ? sentence terminator followed by whitespace. No comma/semicolon/colon split. Reject candidate adjacent to ellipsis, abbreviation/decimal uncertainty, quoted text, code, URL/email/handle.
matching.questions: Explicit question templates may map to questions. Really and and you require terminal ?. Declarative entries reject any terminal ?; do not rewrite OK?/Yes?/I agree? as statements.
matching.quotes: Do not count quoted/reported candidate text as the sender utterance in this first bounded arm.
matching.range: Entire complete unit including terminator where present; all source words must fit native complete token bounds. No inflection root slicing or partial trimming to fit density.
matching.unchanged: Ignore case/punctuation/spacing differences for usefulness. Latin same spelling earns zero useful depth.

outputs.reference_availability: Report whole-message reference separately from an embedded sentence-unit reference. Having a reference is not automatic immersion.
outputs.automatic_mixed: Requested0.10, max1complete native-budget-fitting selected unit, existing content-first/TRAIN-frequency policy, no whole-unit budget fallback.
outputs.full_reference_only: Any2–5word reference failing budget remains available as a reference; no automatic flip is credited.
outputs.content_depth: Count source content-anchor tokens, not every token in a function/formula unit. Also report total replaced-source depth separately.
outputs.known_faces: Research-only simulations of known I/and/but, and all reviewed function units known. Remove already-known atomic source units before selection; do not claim native progression exists.
outputs.union: Deduplicate by message and source range when combining starter words, complete units and existing accepted references.

controls: reviewed starter plus complete short units research projection
evaluation.meaning: Correct/minor/material/scope/uncertain and mandatory-reading judgments; no credit from target occurrence alone.
evaluation.sampling: Freeze targets and exact matcher before choosing a new disjoint conversational sample; preserve prior context for review but never silently feed it into matching.
reported_limits: TRAIN persona dialogue is not worldwide private-chat frequency.
Minimum1token quantizes actual depth above10% in short messages.
Whole-reference availability cannot be counted as an automatic face.
Known-function filtering is a proposed diagnostic, not current native functionality.
